connector.name: Omni Computer Use
connector.registryDescription: A 1:1 replica of Claude Desktop's computer-use tool surface, for Windows and the Claude Code CLI.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package omni-computer-use-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jason26214 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: COMPUTER_USE_MAX_PIXELS
env.description: Max pixels in a downscaled screenshot (default 1200000, ~1.2 MP).

env.name: COMPUTER_USE_MASKING
env.description: Mask non-allowlisted app windows in screenshots ('on'/'off', default off).

env.name: COMPUTER_USE_ENFORCE_FOREGROUND
env.description: Block input when the frontmost app is not allowlisted ('on'/'off', default off).

env.name: COMPUTER_USE_DEV
env.description: Register the reload hot-reload developer tool ('on'/'off', default off).
